title: China's factory prices are rising at the fastest pace in years. Why India's importers should notice
short: China's factory prices jump 5.7%. Why India should notice
dek: For three years China sold the world cheap goods as its factory prices fell. In October they rose 5.7%. What a turn from deflation to inflation in the world's factory means for India, which buys more from China than from anyone else.
card: China's producer prices rose 5.7% in October 2026, after 41 months of falls ended in March. India's phone, pharma and chemical makers lean heavily on Chinese inputs.
